card.name: Chronic or continuous administration wording
card.fires_on: Words that mean long-lasting or ongoing use, such as chronic, chronically administered, continuous, and long-term intravenous infusion, in drug label text. It also fires on the word right after such a cue.

modes.label: After chronic
modes.description: The word chronic, or the word after it, in contrasts between single-dose and long-term use.
modes.example: does not predict the absence of an effect following<< chronic>> administration.

modes.label: Chronic therapy wording
modes.description: The word administered after Chronically in beta-blocker surgery warnings.
modes.example: Major Surgery Chronically<< administered>> beta-blocking therapy should not be routinely withdrawn

modes.label: Continuous infusion
modes.description: Continuous or long-term intravenous infusion, including the word infusion itself.
modes.example: followed by continuous intravenous<< infusion>> as follows

card.plain: It marks wording about long-term or continuous drug use, such as chronic dosing or ongoing infusion.
